popular_table.note: The basic place embed this generator builds is the key-less kind Google offers for simple maps. Directions, Street View panoramas and place-details embeds are different products that do need the Maps Embed API and a key.

faq: Will Google charge me for the embed?

The simple place embed generated here is free and key-less. Charges enter the picture for the API-driven products (dynamic maps, directions, places data) — a different integration than a pasted iframe.
Can I make the map responsive?

Yes — wrap the iframe in a container with a percentage width (and an aspect-ratio or padding trick in CSS) and set the iframe width to 100%. The generator gives you fixed dimensions to start from; your stylesheet makes them fluid.

The basic embed opens in Google's default map view; satellite toggling is available to visitors in the embedded map's own controls where Google offers it. For a guaranteed satellite-first presentation, that is API territory.
Why does my place show the wrong business?
Name collisions: add the street, town or postcode to the query and check the preview. The generator shows you Google's match before you copy anything — trust the preview, not the query.
Does the embed slow my page?
An iframe loads its own resources after your page's HTML — use the loading='lazy' attribute so off-screen maps wait their turn, and keep to one embed per page where you can.
Can I embed multiple locations on one map?
This generator makes single-place embeds. For many pins on one map, build it in the Pin Map Maker or Google My Maps and embed that instead.
Is an API key ever required?
Only when you outgrow the basic embed: directions, Street View, or programmatic control. Most contact pages never do — which is why the key-less generator covers most real websites.
